notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Servos.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Jason Bright by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Servos when Mana Echoes triggers, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
